title: sdk(python): add Shadow Experiments client + retry/backoff alignment
author: Monica Patel
release_notes: Python SDK now supports Shadow Experiments APIs (create/list/get aggregates/sample examples) with consistent retry/backoff behavior for 429/5xx and support for Retry-After.
description:
Summary
Adds first-pass Python SDK support for the Shadow Experiments API (Console backend) used by Shadow Traffic quality metrics. This includes typed request/response models, a dedicated client surface under `client.shadow_experiments`, pagination helpers, and an example script demonstrating end-to-end usage. Also aligns retry/backoff defaults with existing SDK behavior and observed server-side guardrails (429s during sampling spikes, transient 503s when scoring lag/backpressure trips).

Motivation / context
Shadow traffic experiments are created and managed via Console APIs (see linked ENG-5407). Beta customers want a programmatic workflow to (a) create an experiment for a route + candidate variants, (b) poll for aggregates until scoring has stabilized, and (c) pull a small sample of scored examples for debugging. SDK should make this straightforward and safe by default, particularly around retries when the platform is applying backpressure.

What’s included
- New resource: `ShadowExperimentsClient`
  - `create(...)` (POST /v1/shadow-experiments)
  - `get(experiment_id)` (GET /v1/shadow-experiments/{id})
  - `list(route_id=..., status=..., limit=..., cursor=...)`
  - `get_aggregates(experiment_id, window=..., segment=..., metrics=...)`
  - `list_examples(experiment_id, limit=..., cursor=..., filters=...)`
  - `stop(experiment_id)` (POST /v1/shadow-experiments/{id}:stop)
- Typed models for requests/responses, mirroring the Console contract (IDs, variants, sampling config, rubric version, aggregation windows, confidence intervals fields as strings where server returns formatted values).
- Pagination support
  - Consistent `Page[T]` style return for list endpoints: returns items + next_cursor.
  - Iter helper `iter_all(...)` for convenience (bounded by a max_pages safety).
- Retry/backoff alignment
  - Retries for 429 and 5xx where safe.
  - Honors `Retry-After` header when present; otherwise exponential backoff with jitter.
  - Does not retry non-idempotent POSTs by default unless an idempotency key is provided.
  - Adds `idempotency_key` option to `create(...)` and `stop(...)` (propagates `Idempotency-Key`).
- Example usage
  - `examples/shadow_experiments_end_to_end.py` demonstrates:
    1) Create an experiment with 1% sampling and 1 shadow target.
    2) Poll aggregates until scoring lag drops below a threshold.
    3) Fetch 10 scored examples with failed-format filter.

Out of scope / follow-ups
- Streaming-specific knobs and advanced filters: will come once server contract stabilizes during beta.
- Auto-wait helper that blocks until power thresholds / CI width shrink: requested by Applied ML but intentionally deferred.

API surface (Python)
```python
from redwood import Redwood

client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"])

exp = client.shadow_experiments.create(
    route_id="rt_9f0d...",
    name="q2-model-upgrade-shadow",
    sampling_rate=0.01,
    control={"model": "rw/llama-3.1-70b", "revision": "2026-01-15"},
    shadows=[{"model": "rw/llama-3.1-70b", "revision": "2026-02-01", "quantization": "int8"}],
    rubric_version="v1.0",
    idempotency_key="shadowexp-rt_9f0d-2026-02-01",
)

agg = client.shadow_experiments.get_aggregates(exp.id, window="1h")
examples = client.shadow_experiments.list_examples(exp.id, limit=10)
```

Implementation notes
- Transport: reuses existing `HttpClient` but adds a small wrapper to:
  - parse `Retry-After` (seconds or HTTP date).
  - standardize retryable status set for this SDK (429, 500, 502, 503, 504).
- Models: uses the SDK’s existing `BaseModel` + alias mapping. Kept response fields as close to server naming as possible (snake_case client, camelCase over the wire).
- Error handling: introduces `ShadowExperimentNotFoundError` alias of `NotFoundError` only for discoverability; no behavior change.

Changed areas / files
- `redwood/resources/shadow_experiments.py` (new)
- `redwood/types/shadow_experiments/*.py` (new)
- `redwood/_retries.py` (tweak: honor Retry-After, idempotency-aware retry gates)
- `examples/shadow_experiments_end_to_end.py` (new)
- `README.md` (adds section: Shadow Experiments)
- `tests/test_shadow_experiments_client.py` (new)
- `tests/test_retry_after_handling.py` (new)

Screenshots / outputs
- Example run (redacted) included in the example script docstring; no screenshots.

Testing
- Unit tests for request serialization + pagination cursor handling.
- Retry tests cover: 429 with Retry-After, 503 without Retry-After, non-retry for POST without idempotency key.

Rollout / compatibility
- No breaking changes.
- Feature flags/gating is server-side; SDK will surface 403/404 if tenant not enabled.

Review notes
- The server contract is still evolving; I’ve kept the models permissive and avoided hard enums for metric names/segments.
- Please pay extra attention to idempotency + retries on create/stop.

Review conversation (highlights)
- Jada Williams: “Can we avoid retrying create() by default? We saw double-creates in early internal dogfood.”
  - Monica Patel: “Done. POST retries disabled unless idempotency_key is passed; added tests.”
- Allison Grant: “Honor Retry-After; we’re using it for 429 and occasionally 503 during backpressure.”
  - Monica Patel: “Implemented parsing for both delta-seconds and HTTP-date formats; added unit tests.”
- Chloe Martin: “Examples endpoint returns `confidence_interval` as a formatted string today; don’t coerce.”
  - Monica Patel: “Left as string in models; added TODO to tighten once backend ships numeric fields.”
- Dylan Brooks: “Naming: prefer `shadow_experiments` to match other resources.”
  - Monica Patel: “Updated: `client.shadow_experiments.*`.

CI
- ✅ lint (ruff)
- ✅ formatting (black)
- ✅ typecheck (mypy)
- ✅ unit tests (pytest)

Linked work
- Linear: ENG-5418 (SDK support), ENG-5407 (Console API)

Notes for release
- This will ship in the next minor release once backend beta is enabled for the first Dedicated tenants; no doc site changes required beyond README/example for now.
